findings.current: which had long since lost their light
findings.defect: Adds an unsupported duration. The Korean says the black knight's eyes had already lost their light, not that they had been without it for a long time.
findings.rationale: 이미 means “already”; long since adds a temporal implication absent from the source.
findings.replacement: which had already lost their light

findings.current: The thought left him feeling strangely unsettled.
findings.defect: Drops the source's suddenness and the explicit framing that the thought had suddenly occurred to him.
findings.rationale: 문득 떠오른 생각 establishes a sudden thought as the trigger for his strange feeling.
findings.replacement: The thought that suddenly occurred to him left the black knight feeling strange.

findings.current: then personally taken the vanguard of one legion and come here
findings.defect: Softens 선봉장, which identifies the black knight as the vanguard commander, into merely taking the vanguard position.
findings.rationale: The source gives him a command role, not only a position at the front.
findings.replacement: then personally become the commander of one legion’s vanguard and come here

findings.current: The black knight was the one who had devised the discipline and formations ordinary monsters lacked.
findings.defect: Drops the source's 역시, which establishes that the black knight was also the one responsible for devising this discipline and formation.
findings.rationale: 역시 carries the additive “also” relation preserved by the accepted baseline.
findings.replacement: The black knight was also the one who had devised the discipline and formations ordinary monsters lacked.

findings.defect: Omits the magnitude of the vibration.
findings.rationale: 거대한 진동 describes a tremendous or enormous vibration, an important physical detail of the advancing legion.
findings.replacement: A tremendous vibration shook the earth.

findings.current: Tens of thousands of monsters roared as one.
findings.defect: Drops the source's emphasis that this was an enormous roar and adds unsupported unanimity with “as one.”
findings.rationale: The Korean presents an enormous collective roar as a sound image; it does not state that the monsters roared in unison.
findings.replacement: The enormous roar of tens of thousands of monsters.

findings.current: Magic Johnson was genuinely furious—and at the same time, deeply saddened.
findings.defect: Adds an intensity not established by the source's plain statement that he was sad.
findings.rationale: 한편으로는 슬퍼하는 중 means he was also sad; deeply intensifies that emotional state.
findings.replacement: Magic Johnson was genuinely furious—and at the same time, sad.

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful, with several minor source-fidelity regressions involving omitted emphasis, added duration or intensity, and one softened command-role detail.
